test_cases.title: The Customers list moves to its next page
acs: DERIVED: The pager on Customers moves to the next page of customers (data/depth2.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx, click Manage Contracts then Customers.
Read the first row of the list.

steps.expected: The list reloads with the h1 Customers.

steps.action: Read the first row of the list again.
steps.expected: The first row differs from the one on page 1.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: Selecting a year keeps the page and shows no error
acs: DERIVED: Year selectors on Weighted Pricing Plan, Postage Pricing Plan and Test Types reload the page - 9 years (data/depth2.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
The table contents for each year are not checked.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 9 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx and click the links of the path in the current row.
steps.expected: The detail page opens with its heading.

steps.action: Select the year named in the row from the year dropdown.

steps.expected: The h1 matches the heading in the row.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: A customer search by a known QAL number lists that customer
acs: DERIVED: Searching Manage Contracts > Search by QAL number QAL/0344 lists that customer (data/depth2.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
The seeded customer QAL/0344 exists in the local data.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx, click Manage Contracts then Search.
Type QAL/0344 in the QAL Number box.

steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Search.
A row for QAL/0344 is listed.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.
